title: Pairs of lattice complements with complementary homology
summary: In this paper we study whether there is a global to local principle for the homology of order complexes of finite lattices. We explore whether the non-vanishing of the homology of a lattice in degree $a+b-2$ forces the existence of a pair of lattice-complements whose open intervals below have non-vanishing homology in degrees $a$ and $b$ respectively. We consider the same question also in the language of multigraded free resolutions. We provide positive evidence for the existence of such pairs and give counterexamples to strengthenings of the question.
